title: Consultancy – Board Performance Evaluation
description: Request for Proposal for an independent consultancy to conduct a comprehensive performance evaluation of the PASS Trust Board of Trustees, its committees (HR, Audit/Risk/Compliance, Business), and individual members. Deliverables include inception report, evaluation report, action plan, and board presentation.

contact.name: Procurement Department
contact.address: PASS Trust, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania

eligibility: Legally registered consulting firm with 5–10 years board evaluation experience; permanent staff only (no subcontractors or freelancers).
